prompt: Update a gameplay HUD to show health, stamina, and a temporary objective without obscuring the center playfield.
acceptance_criteria: Reads actual state owner; prioritizes glanceable values; includes low-health non-color cue; adapts safe insets; tests representative state.

prompt: Fix a segmented health bar whose spoken value and low-health warning can disagree.
acceptance_criteria: Single authoritative value drives visual and spoken state; tests clamping and low/normal transitions; reports platform-test limits.

prompt: Add selection and Equip behavior to a dense inventory grid with locked, new, and equipped items.
acceptance_criteria: Stable keyed slots; clear selected detail and disabled reason; empty/loading/error states; keyboard/controller focus remains usable.

prompt: Add a purchase-pending state to a shop screen where users can currently tap Buy repeatedly.
acceptance_criteria: Uses existing billing/state owner; prevents duplicate in-flight action; shows price and pending/failure/cancel; no client-granted entitlement.

prompt: Repair a pause menu that opens with no focused item and loses focus after closing Settings.
acceptance_criteria: Visible initial focus; predictable directional/confirm/cancel behavior; focus restoration; preserves Back semantics; tests supported input path.

prompt: Add a reward burst animation that must stop when the user enables reduced motion mid-animation.
acceptance_criteria: Motion preference observed; in-flight effect settles without losing reward state; deterministic regression test; no claim without execution.

prompt: A custom View keeps drawing after its screen is detached and recreates its surface incorrectly after resume.
acceptance_criteria: Traces attachment/surface ownership; cancels callbacks and releases context resources; handles recreation; lifecycle regression coverage.

prompt: Inspect a game UI loop that advances simulation with frame delta and becomes unstable after a long pause.
acceptance_criteria: Separates simulation/update policy from render; uses project loop contract; caps/catches up deliberately; no competing loop or unsupported smoothness claim.

prompt: Inventory scrolling janks after adding animated item counts to every grid cell.
acceptance_criteria: Measures/reproduces on comparable journey; scopes rapidly changing state; avoids speculative annotations; reports before/after evidence or limitation.

prompt: A custom Canvas joystick has no accessible action or state description.
acceptance_criteria: Provides meaningful semantic action/state and alternative input path; visual control remains discoverable; TalkBack/device verification status explicit.

prompt: Long Arabic and Vietnamese item names clip in a shop card.
acceptance_criteria: Uses resource/localization pipeline; handles RTL, long strings, font fallback and diacritics; layout remains usable at supported font scale.

prompt: A landscape tablet inventory leaves large empty gutters and clips on a compact split-screen window.
acceptance_criteria: Uses app window constraints rather than device labels; preserves information hierarchy and stable selection; validates compact and expanded sizes.

prompt: Releasing the second finger sometimes leaves a virtual joystick stuck when fire is also held.
acceptance_criteria: Tracks pointer IDs and ownership; handles pointer-up/cancel/window loss; doesn't transfer gesture into gameplay; regression tests event order.

prompt: A delayed inventory response updates a screen after the Activity is destroyed and recreated.
acceptance_criteria: Finds async/state owner; cancels or rejects stale work appropriately; durable state stays outside view; recreation test covers behavior.

prompt: A new inventory field breaks loading saves created by the previous released version.
acceptance_criteria: Inspects schema/version owner; preserves old save behavior with migration/default; tests old and new data; no UI-only data authority.

prompt: Leaderboard shows a blank screen when the player is offline and retry is tapped quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Represents offline/loading/error/empty/success; retry is safe and idempotent; localized accessible feedback; service authority unchanged.

prompt: A match result dialog trusts a client-supplied score and offers Submit again after timeout.
acceptance_criteria: UI communicates pending/timeout/reconnect truthfully; backend remains authoritative; duplicate submission strategy is preserved; security boundary explicit.

prompt: A rewarded-ad button grants coins immediately on tap, before provider completion.
acceptance_criteria: Reward only follows trusted completion callback/state; pending/failure/cancel visible; consent/policy path inspected; tests provider-state mapping.

prompt: A button's visual pressed state stays active after a gesture is canceled by system Back.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduces or traces cancel path; fixes owner/lifecycle cause; adds focused regression; verifies unrelated click behavior remains.

prompt: Refactor nested shop dialogs to remove duplicated state without changing Back or restore behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Maps current flow and state owner; smallest clear abstraction; Back/cancel/focus restoration tests; no broad unrelated migration.

prompt: A screenshot baseline changed after a font update and CI wants to auto-record the new image.
acceptance_criteria: Compares intentional output and text states; reviews diff; doesn't blindly overwrite baseline; records deterministic environment/tool versions.

prompt: A Compose animation test passes locally but flakes on CI after an arbitrary sleep.
acceptance_criteria: Investigates timing/root cause; uses deterministic clock or condition-based wait; proves failure/pass behavior; avoids raising timeout as sole fix.

prompt: Review a game UI change touching shop, reduced motion, and accessibility before release.
acceptance_criteria: Findings first by impact with file evidence; covers regression/tests/policy boundary; distinguishes verified, partial, and unverified.

prompt: Port a Views segmented bar template into a project with older minSdk and different AndroidX versions.
acceptance_criteria: Checks actual Gradle/API/resources/imports/lifecycle; adapts or rejects incompatible calls; builds/tests when possible; no guessed compatibility claims.
